## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Nîmes, France. It starts at Boulevard des Arènes.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> A **feat of ancient engineering**, the Arena of Nîmes is one of the best-preserved amphitheaters – it dates back to 100 AD, just a few years after the Romans built the Colosseum.
>
> Of the 300 still-standing Roman amphitheaters, this is one of the biggest. At the peak of the Roman Empire, up to 24,000 people would gather to watch gladiator battles and animal hunts at _Les Arènes de Nîmes_, or the Nîmes Arena.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.50. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 139 ratings and 72 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
